visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static shot from an indoor perspective looking out of an open white-framed window. A vibrant red flag with an intricate gold heraldic crest and text containing "MADE" ripples strongly in the wind. In the background, the sun-dappled blue waters of Lake Como are visible with a small white boat and steep green mountains under a clear sky. (2) A handheld medium shot shows an outdoor terrace restaurant shaded by a large, leafy green tree. A woman with blonde hair, wearing a white off-the-shoulder top, a long pastel pink pleated skirt, and white-framed sunglasses, sits at a white-clothed table. Other diners are seated at nearby tables against the backdrop of the lake and mountains. (3) A close-up shot on a white-clothed table shows a green champagne bottle with a pink label pouring sparkling wine into a glass flute. Another glass already contains the pinkish liquid. A silver salt and pepper set and a bread basket are partially visible in the bright natural light. (4) An extreme close-up focuses on a gourmet salad in a white and gold bowl. A silver fork lifts a piece of pink lobster meat from a bed of fresh greens, yellow citrus sauce, and cherry tomatoes. The food is brightly lit by overhead natural sunlight. (5) The shot moves to a tray with three small white bowls containing strawberries, lemon sorbet with a mint leaf, and yellow gelato topped with nuts. A spoon scoops from the yellow gelato. White sunglasses rest on the table in the background. (6) A final handheld panning shot shows the restaurant terrace under orange-striped awnings. Multiple groups of people are seated at tables, enjoying the view of the calm lake and distant misty mountains under a bright, clear sky.
